concept.title: Generic Topic
concept.shortdesc: A generic topic is assigned when no dominant classification signal is found — no action

conbody.p:
A generic topic is assigned when no dominant classification signal is found — no action verb with a numbered list, no lookup-data table, no overview keyword, and no troubleshooting structure. The converter defaults to the generic type with a plain , placing all content as

and list elements in document order.
